name: principalwp
description: Principal WP's public Claude Code toolkit.

plugins.name: principalwp-toolkit
plugins.description: Principal WP's Claude Code tools in one install: htmlizer (turn a plan, review, or design into an interactive local HTML page and get the reader's feedback back into the session), wp-prototype (clickable single-file mockups of WordPress admin UI), writing-for-llms and anti-ai-slop (write and sharpen skills, agents, and prose), and the WordPress Starter Pipeline (one WordPress component change to a reviewed, tested PR through gated agent phases).
